root_cause.text: uinput_request_send() acquires udev->mutex while holding ff->mutex, which together with other code paths that acquire udev->mutex and eventually re-acquire ff->mutex creates a circular locking dependency.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states the cycle "ff->mutex -> udev->mutex -> input_mutex -> dev->mutex -> ff->mutex" and describes the four lock acquisition paths, including that input_ff_upload() holds ff->mutex and calls uinput_request_send() which acquires udev->mutex. The fix replaces udev->mutex in uinput_request_send() with a spinlock to break the cycle.
